title: On the Reception and Detection of Pseudo-Profound Bullshit

publication.publisher_or_container: Judgment and Decision Making, Vol. 10, No. 6

verification.verification_notes: Confirmed the studies and finding: syntactically well-formed but vacuous 'pseudo-profound' statements are rated as profound, and this receptivity is associated with intuitive cognitive style and lower reflectiveness.

copyright.notes: Open-access journal article; examples not reproduced; analytical citation only.
